name: Arvandec Mellat Bank Gateway for WooCommerce
author: Arvandec

sections.description:
This plugin integrates the BehPardakht (Bank Mellat) payment gateway with WooCommerce, enabling merchants to accept online payments directly through their Mellat Bank account.
It supports secure transaction handling, error logging, and order status updates automatically after successful payments.
The plugin is developed and maintained by Arvandec and is not affiliated with Bank Mellat or BehPardakht.

Key Features:

  • ✅ Easy installation and setup
  • ✅ Compatible with latest WooCommerce versions
  • ✅ HPOS Compatible – Fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage
  • ✅ Traditional shortcode checkout support
  • ✅ MultiCurrency support
  • ✅ High security and standard coding
  • ✅ No advertisements or extra code
  • ✅ Completely free – forever and always

MultiCurrency Plugins Support:

This plugin is compatible with popular MultiCurrency plugins:

  • WooCommerce MultiCurrency
  • WPML Multi-Currency
  • Aelia Currency Switcher
  • CURCY – WooCommerce Multi Currency
  • And other multi-currency plugins

How it works:

The plugin automatically detects the current cart currency and Mellat payment gateway will only be displayed when the selected iranian currency.

Configuration

After activation, go to:

WooCommerce > Settings > Payments > Mellat Bank

  • Enable/Disable – Gateway status
  • Title – Name that customer sees on checkout page
  • Description – Help text for customer
  • Terminal ID – Terminal ID received from Mellat Bank
  • Username – Username received from Mellat Bank
  • Password – Password received from Mellat Bank

Our Commitment

This plugin will remain free forever

We are committed to the WordPress community and provide this plugin completely free of charge without any time limitations. There are no plans for commercialization or adding advertisements in the future.

Our goal is to provide a simple, secure and stable solution for the Persian WordPress community.

Support

If this plugin has been useful for you, you can support its development by giving it a star or recommending it to others.

External Services

This plugin connects to the BehPardakht (Bank Mellat) payment gateway through the official API endpoint at https://bpm.shaparak.ir/pgwchannel/services/pgw?wsdl

It sends the following data to the service when processing payments:
– Order amount
– Order ID
– Callback URL
– Terminal ID and credentials provided by the merchant

The service is provided by BehPardakht Mellat (https://www.behpardakht.com).
You can review their Terms of Service and Privacy Policy at:
https://www.behpardakht.ir/CustomerViolationsDescription.html
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin zip file through WordPress admin and activate it
  2. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments
  3. Enable Mellat Bank payment gateway
  4. Enter gateway information (Terminal ID, Username, Password)
  5. Save settings
sections.faq:
Is this plugin free?

Yes, this plugin is completely free and will remain free forever. There are no charges for using it.

Does it contain ads or extra code?

No, this plugin is completely clean and contains no advertisements, sponsor links or extra code.

Which multi-currency plugins are supported?

It’s compatible with most popular MultiCurrency plugins. Full list is available in the description above.

Does it support Rial and Toman?

Yes, it fully supports both IRR (Rial) and IRT (Toman).

How can I report an issue?

You can report issues through [https://arvandec.com/contact].
